# DocKit

> Renter-controlled copilot that checks affordable-housing paperwork on the renter's own device (OCR + EXIF), then hands a review-ready packet to a housing office. Never decides eligibility — humans always do.

- Site: https://the-dockit.vercel.app
- Docs: https://the-dockit.vercel.app (landing)

## Key pages

- [/](https://the-dockit.vercel.app/) — What DocKit is and how it works
- [/auth](https://the-dockit.vercel.app/auth) — Sign in / create housing office account

## What DocKit is not

- Not a chatbot; not a conversational LLM interface
- Not an eligibility decision engine
- No cloud AI calls — document text recognition runs 100% in the renter's browser

## Contact

Public preview only; contact the operator listed on the site.
